description: Defines a templated class QuicIntervalDeque for managing intervals associated with items, optimized for sequential and binary search operations, used in packet buffering and retransmission scenarios.

classes.name: quic::QuicIntervalDeque
classes.description: A templated container class that manages items with associated intervals, supporting efficient sequential and binary search operations.

classes.name: quic::QuicIntervalDeque::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing QuicIntervalDeque, supporting increment, dereference, and comparison operations.

methods.name: PushBack
methods.description: Adds an item to the container, expects the item's interval to be strictly greater than the last added.

methods.name: PopFront
methods.description: Removes the front item and its interval from the container.

methods.name: DataBegin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the data.

methods.name: DataEnd
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the data.

methods.name: DataAt
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the item corresponding to a specific interval beginning.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the container.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the container is empty.
